text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races
together with Daiichi Rubyâ

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Moving on, regarding tomorrow's interview...

During our meeting, when I opened my planner
to check the schedule...
(Flutter...)

Picking up what had fallen, I see that
it's a hot spring trip voucher.
I definitely remembered having one.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...That's the event we held at the shopping district
back at the start of the Senior Year, right?
Back then, I decided, "I will save this until I become someone respectable, like Daiichi Ruby," and kept it as it was until today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that you discovered it just now
may mean that the time has come."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Since there are no big races coming up,
why not go on a trip?

I think I've grown compared to before,
but even so, I don't feel like I've become a presence on par with Daiichi Ruby.
choice_data_list: I'm still in the middle of my mission, after all
I'm still in the middle of my mission, you know

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is I.
Send a car to the academy immediately.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Please follow me.

Daiichi Ruby brought me
to the hot spring inn listed on the travel voucher.
While I was surprised by her sudden actionâ

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: An ambition to improve is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "However, the hurdles one sets for oneself only get higher as you grow."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
the day when you can rest will never come."
choice_data_list: Is that why you brought me here?
Is that why you brought me here?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Even from my perspective, Trainer,
you've been working non-stop lately."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please use this opportunity to turn over a new leaf
and recharge your spirits to move forward once more.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What might it be?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I have no reason to linger here.
choice_data_list: If anything, you have more of a reason than anyone.
If anything, you're the one who has a reason, aren't you?

text_block_list.text: "If taking a proper rest now will lead to positive growth... and if that's the conclusion reached, then it is precisely what she, working so hard, truly needs."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, there is nothing. I simply still have things that need to be done...
choice_data_list: Then I can't just sit around resting either.
Then I can't just sit around resting either.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: This time, let us respect your wishes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I shall also be
taking the day off today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
see you later.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: Were you able to relax and have a good soak?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
How about you,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: I was able to get a proper refresh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see.
choice_data_list: ...Why did you stay behind for me?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Just felt like it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Is it truly so strange
for me to make decisions on a whim?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't have anything particular in mind.
Back then, when I heard what you had to say...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I felt it was fine for us to stay together.
That is why I nodded... That is all.

She fell silent. It seemed she had no intention
of explaining any further.
Still... that was enough.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I haven't done anything
to warrant such praise, however.
choice_data_list: For guiding me all this time
For guiding me all this time

text_block_list.text: Watching her constantly strive for her mission, I wanted to grow alongside her. My ideals are still far away, but even so...
choice_data_list: I kinda like who I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you will continue to
strive toward your ideals in the future as well."

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
between myself and Daiichi Ruby...
